plugin.name: Wbcom Designs - BuddyPress Job Manager
optional_plugins: WP Job Manager - Applications (unlocks the Applied Jobs subnav + the BP application notification path)
WP Job Manager - Resume Manager (unlocks the whole Resumes nav, resume profile fields, candidate dashboard filters)
WP Job Manager - Bookmarks (unlocks the My Bookmarks subnav)
WP Job Manager - Alerts (unlocks the Job Alerts subnav)
BuddyBoss Platform (accepted in place of BuddyPress)

requirements.note: BuddyPress is NOT in the Requires Plugins header (it names a plugin folder and would block BuddyBoss Platform); it is checked at runtime via class_exists('BuddyPress') in bpjm_plugin_init().

settings.default: option absent -> all three toggles OFF. No activation default is written (Bp_Job_Manager_Globals leaves the properties null and every consumer requires === 'yes'). A key present in the option means yes; the General tab sentinels remove a key when its checkbox is cleared.
settings.note: Three toggles only. Role arrays and bpjm_resume_at_profile were removed in 3.0.0; legacy values may remain in the option on upgraded sites and are ignored. The Resume Activity toggle renders only when Resume Manager is active, the Application Notification toggle only when Applications is active.
also_stored: bpjm_job_application_pgid (legacy option; read by Bp_Job_Manager_Globals, used only by bpjm_is_apply_page() to style a pre-existing Apply To Job page; no longer written; deleted on uninstall)
bp-job-manager_activation_date, bp-job-manager_no_bug (review-nag state, site options, Bp_Job_Manager_Feedback; deleted on uninstall)

static_analysis.stale_findings_removed: Refresh 2026-11-17: every findings array was already empty; no stale finding to drop. Verified each against current code instead (no AJAX, REST, cron, blocks: dead_listeners / rest_hang_risks / js_only_activation cannot apply).

coverage_notes: DEPENDENCY TRUTH: hard-requires BuddyPress (runtime class_exists; BuddyBoss Platform satisfies it) and WP Job Manager (Requires Plugins header + class_exists), checked at bp-job-manager.php:105-139 independent of the current user. Applications, Resume Manager, Bookmarks and Alerts are OPTIONAL, each detected via bpjm_is_plugin_active() and each gating one nav/notification surface.

ACTIVITY WRITES USE transition_post_status (not publish_job_listing / publish_resume): bpjm_publish_job_listing and bpjm_publish_resume self-filter to the publish transition. Trash and permanent delete both remove the activity (bpjm_delete_job_activity).

BP_Job_Manager_Feedback is SELF-INSTANTIATING at file scope and registers its own admin_init / admin_notices hooks; it is not wired through Bp_Job_Manager_Loader. Its class name matches neither the Bp_Job_Manager_* prefix nor its file name.
WPML: the two count transients get a language suffix when ICL_LANGUAGE_CODE is defined but are invalidated un-suffixed (see transients).

Refresh 2026-11-17 removed these stale entries: Resume Fields subnav + xProfile nonces, bpjm_resume_fields_custom_slug filter, bpjm_resume_at_profile gating, four deleted templates, the Activator/Deactivator classes, the old transient key names (user_{ID}_job_listings), and the re-emit of resume_manager_my_resume_actions / _candidate_dashboard_login_url (their template and call site are gone).

profile_tabs: Jobs - bp_setup_nav -> bpjm_member_profile_jobs_tab (nav slug 'jobs', position 75, default subnav my-jobs). The tab exists on the member's OWN profile, or on someone else's only when they have at least one job (no role gate since 3.0.0). Subnavs: my-jobs (always), my-bookmarks (own profile + wp-job-manager-bookmarks), job-alerts (own + wp-job-manager-alerts), applied-jobs (own + wp-job-manager-applications; moved here from Resumes in 3.0.1), post-job (own).

Resumes - bp_setup_nav -> bpjm_member_profile_resumes_tab, registered only when wp-job-manager-resumes is active. Visible on the own profile, or on another's only when they have resumes AND resume_manager_user_can_browse_resumes() allows the visitor. Nav slug 'resumes', default subnav my-resumes; add-resume subnav on own profile. /resumes/applied-jobs/ redirects to the Jobs tab (bpjm_redirect_old_applied_jobs). The Resume Fields / xProfile visibility screen was removed.
buddypress_integration.admin_bar: Bp_Job_Manager_Admin::bpjm_setup_admin_bar_links (bp_setup_admin_bar @70). Logged-in users only: a Resumes My Account menu (My Resumes, Add Resume) when bpjm_user_can_apply_job() and Resume Manager is active, and a Jobs menu (My Jobs, Applied Jobs when Applications is active, Post Job) when bpjm_user_can_post_job(). Both carry a live count badge.
buddypress_integration.notifications: Component bpjm_notify_actions, two actions: applied_job (to the job owner; written by bpjm_add_bp_notification_for_job_post on job_manager_applications_new_job_application, applicant taken from the application's _candidate_user_id) and application_status (to the candidate when an application's status changes; bpjm_notify_application_status on transition_post_status). Both gated on the bpjm_app_notify setting AND bp_is_active('notifications'). Registered via bp_notifications_get_registered_components, rendered by bpjm_job_application_notifications on bp_notifications_get_notifications_for_user @11, text of applied_job filterable via _bprwg_notification_text. Visiting the owner's applications marks them read (bpjm_mark_application_notifications_read).
buddypress_integration.messaging: Send Private Message link on the candidate contact block - bpjm_add_private_message_link on resume_manager_contact_details. No-ops unless bp_is_active('messages'); BP >= 12.0.0 uses bp_members_get_user_slug().

compat.bp_rewrites: includes/class-bp-job-manager.php:339-343 (only when bp-rewrites/class-bp-rewrites.php is active): bp_nouveau_get_nav_link -> bpjm_nouveau_link_fix and bp_setup_nav @9999 -> bpjm_legacy_link_fix. The Youzify branches were removed with the Resume Fields screen.

buddypress_integration.activity: Types bpjm_job_post and bpjm_resume_publish registered on bp_register_activity_actions (Bp_Job_Manager_Admin::bpjm_register_activity_actions). Written on transition_post_status to publish (jobs gated on bpjm_job_post_activity, resumes on bpjm_resume_activity); removed on wp_trash_post / before_delete_post. Text is built once at render time through bpjm_format_activity so it follows the reader's language.
buddypress_integration.submission_actions: 3.0.1: bpjm_handle_submission_actions (wp @9) runs duplicate/continue/relist/renew on the member's own Jobs tab; bpjm_handle_resume_relist (wp @9) does the same for resumes. Each verifies the owning plugin's own nonce plus its edit-permission check.

frontend_assets.enqueue_gate: Bp_Job_Manager_Public::bpjm_needs_public_assets() (CSS) and bpjm_is_owned_action() (JS): current BuddyPress action in bpjm_get_owned_actions() (filter bpjm_owned_profile_actions; jobs, my-jobs, applied-jobs, post-job, my-resumes, add-resume, job-alerts, my-bookmarks) or the Apply To Job page. A standalone [job_dashboard] page is deliberately NOT matched (4828d05).

nonces: job_manager_my_job_actions (WP Job Manager's own action) - verified in bpjm_handle_submission_actions together with job_manager_user_can_edit_job()
resume_manager_my_resume_actions (Resume Manager's own action) - verified in bpjm_handle_resume_relist
bp-job-manager-feedback-nounce - review-nag dismissal; minted/checked in admin/class-bp-job-manager-admin-feedback.php (paired with current_user_can('manage_options'))
security.uninstall: uninstall.php (guarded by WP_UNINSTALL_PLUGIN) deletes bpjm_general_settings, bpjm_job_application_pgid, bp-job-manager_activation_date and bp-job-manager_no_bug (site options too on multisite) and runs one LIKE delete over the bpjm count transients.
notes: No AJAX endpoints exist (the nopriv bpjm_load_more_jobs endpoint was removed in 3.0.1), no REST routes, no custom caps, no tables.
The activation redirect is transient-driven (_bpjm_is_new_install), not nonce-driven.

coding_rules: Hooks wired through Bp_Job_Manager_Loader; business classes avoid direct add_action (exceptions: Bp_Job_Manager_Admin_Panel::register(), constructor-time AJAX/filters in Public, BP screen-function callbacks, and the self-instantiating BP_Job_Manager_Feedback).

NEW card-panel admin wrapper: one page (slug 'bp-job-manager') under the shared parent slug 'wbcomplugins', 4 tabs routed through includes/admin/views/shell.php. The OLD admin/wbcom/ wrapper was removed in 2.8.5.
Settings save uses the sentinel-guarded merge pattern (bpjm_tab_rendered_keys / bpjm_array_rendered_keys) — see settings[0].save_contract.

storage_policy: Apart from bpjm_general_settings and two regenerable count transients, this plugin writes nothing. No tables, no post types, no user meta, no auto-created pages. Activation writes only a 30-second redirect flag.
notes_3_0_1: BP notification component bpjm_notify_actions: actions applied_job (to job owner) and application_status (to candidate). Applied Jobs subnav moved to the Jobs tab; /resumes/applied-jobs/ redirects.
Jobs and Resumes tabs follow the same rule: shown on the own profile, or on another's when they have items. A visitor Resume Manager will not let browse resumes gets no Resumes tab.

Hand-rolled templates for resume listing, applied jobs and single resume were removed; the screens render WP Job Manager / Resume Manager shortcodes inside a .bpjm-screen wrapper (bpjm_screen_open/close on bp_template_content).
Activity text is built in one place (bpjm_activity_text) and formatted at render time in the reader's language.
The empty out-of-range page notice and 390px admin overflow were fixed after the 3.0.1 manifest; BuddyBoss activation is accepted via class_exists('BuddyPress').
